tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The ground behind the floating panes. Only the header bar sits directly on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Work surfaces: the stage, chat, cards inside trays, drawers, popovers, the composer.

tokens.name: tray
tokens.usage: Grouping surface: the Plan panel, side nav, list trays, file and table rails. Holds white cards; grouping comes from this step, not from lines.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: Selected row, active nav item, active segment track, your chat bubbles, hover.

tokens.name: button-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of a secondary or icon button on a surface. Never the same as the surface behind it (M5.9.1).

tokens.name: button-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Secondary or icon button hover on a surface.

tokens.name: button-fill-on-tray
tokens.usage: Fill of a secondary or icon button on the tray, the canvas or a selected row: it steps up from the ground, so it never blends in.

tokens.name: button-fill-on-tray-hover
tokens.usage: Secondary or icon button hover on the tray, the canvas or a selected row.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline on panes, cards and between rows. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-ctl
tokens.usage: Outline of anything you can press that relies on its border: secondary buttons, pills, inputs, the composer, outline status marks. 4.5:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons. 16:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, sub-lines, meta. 9.7:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Placeholder text and tertiary meta only. 6.4:1 on surface; never for anything you must read to act.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one primary button per screen, the active stepper stage, the preview dock.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring (2px, 2px offset) and the preview highlight outline.

tokens.name: works
tokens.usage: Status: works (checked). Icon and word only; never a fill behind finished rows.

tokens.name: works-bg
tokens.usage: Behind the works icon.

tokens.name: building
tokens.usage: Status: building now; also the Test version badge.

tokens.name: building-bg
tokens.usage: Behind the building icon and Test version badge.

tokens.name: attention
tokens.usage: Status: needs a connection or uses sample data. Something the user can fix.

tokens.name: attention-bg
tokens.usage: Behind the attention icon.

tokens.name: approval
tokens.usage: Status: waiting for an admin. The user can only wait or remind.

tokens.name: approval-bg
tokens.usage: Behind the approval icon.

tokens.name: failed
tokens.usage: Status: a check failed and Architect is fixing it, or an error. Never used for blocked.

tokens.name: failed-bg
tokens.usage: Behind the failed icon.

tokens.name: primary-disabled
tokens.usage: A primary button that cannot be pressed yet, always with the reason next to it. White text passes 5.3:1.

color.artRule: Brand and art tokens are for pictures only (rules in docs/build/notes/23-brand-layer-v4.md). They are CSS variables, not Tailwind colours, and test/unit/brand-tokens.test.ts fails if one is used outside the picture components.

art.name: brand-moss
art.usage: The logo mark, the Home greeting full stop, the credits bar fill, finished mosaic cells, agent glyph dots. Darker and greyer than works: it is never a status. Pictures only: never on a button, badge, link, status or text next to a status.

art.name: brand-fern
art.usage: The mosaic cell of a part being built. Pictures only: never on a button, badge, link, status or text next to a status.

art.name: brand-lime
art.usage: A beat of the build loader; landing highlights. Pictures only: never on a button, badge, link, status or text next to a status.

art.name: brand-mist
art.usage: The agent glyph tile and the empty-state ground; brand-mist-cell is an unstarted mosaic cell. Pictures only: never on a button, badge, link, status or text next to a status.

art.name: art-peony
art.usage: A picture accent, one per project. Pictures only: never on a button, badge, link, status or text next to a status.

art.name: art-tangerine
art.usage: A picture accent, one per project. Pictures only: never on a button, badge, link, status or text next to a status.

art.name: art-yolk
art.usage: A picture accent, one per project. Pictures only: never on a button, badge, link, status or text next to a status.

art.name: art-lilac
art.usage: A picture accent, one per project. Not the approval violet. Pictures only: never on a button, badge, link, status or text next to a status.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page and document titles; one per screen.
styles.sample: A Slack brief before every meeting

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: Section titles, project name, lead paragraphs at 400.
styles.sample: Before your team can use it

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Everything you read and every control label.
styles.sample: Briefs show sample email threads until Architect can read yours.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Part names, card titles, button labels on primary.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Descriptions under a name, meta, counts. Always ink-2 or ink.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Group headers inside trays, field labels. Sentence case, never uppercase.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code, file names, URLs, terminal. Nothing else.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between controls in a row; gap between panes.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Pane gutter; tray inset.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (compact), row padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel and card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Drawer padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Document side padding.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Page top padding on Home and empty states.

tokens.name: radius-pane
tokens.usage: Floating panes, side nav, trays.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, rows inside trays, frames, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Icon tiles, status icon squares in tables.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Every button, pill, segmented control, stepper, badge.

tokens.name: shadow-pane
tokens.usage: Floating panes on the canvas.

tokens.name: shadow-hero
tokens.usage: The Home composer only.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, the preview dock.

tokens.name: shadow-drawer
tokens.usage: Drawers over a scrim.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Default button and icon button height.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons inside cards and rows; pills.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Smallest hit area allowed (text links).

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: A collapsed Plan or Chat panel.

tokens.name: plan-panel
tokens.usage: Plan panel width.

tokens.name: chat-panel
tokens.usage: Chat panel width.

tokens.name: motion-fast
tokens.usage: Hover and press.

tokens.name: motion-base
tokens.usage: Cards, hints and messages appearing or changing.

tokens.name: motion-slow
tokens.usage: Panes opening and closing; the build's tick drawing in.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: The one easing, everywhere. Nothing takes longer than 400ms; animate only opacity and transform.
